channels.function: Transcript::challenge_indices over the public prefix; stage 1 of the joint-view tool re-derives every index from public data and this gate re-reads them from that replay
channels.note: derived, not sampled by the prover

channels.model_assumption: the salts are fresh uniform bytes in both worlds and equality of the two laws rests on M-3, the assumption that the whole output stream of the generator the code uses (ZkRng) is indistinguishable from uniform, including in the direction that published later outputs do not reveal earlier secret ones

the roots are generated by the prover itself under ruling D18, no oracle point is programmed, and indistinguishability of the two worlds' roots rests on M-2, the hiding of unopened salted leaves in the random-oracle model
the paths are genuine hashes of the same world's own columns; hiding of the roughly 212.5 unopened leaf digests and of the internal nodes above them per 2,048-leaf tree rests on M-2

channels.fibre_dim_real: the same matrix: R_s and the sum weights are functions of the replayed challenges and the slot geometry only
channels.how: the CFS mask coefficients are solved per slot and every published round entry is recomputed from (fixed transcript, coefficients)
channels.per_slot_statement: for slot s the gate exhibits mask coefficients with masked_round_j = honest_round_j + c_s g_s.round(j, rho_<j) at EVERY round and evaluation point, for a named fixed honest transcript; the remaining freedom is one Fp2 coefficient direction per slot

channels.how: the same coefficients, through CfsMask::sum_weights: scalar_s = honest_scalar_s + c_s * <sum_weights, coef_s>, recomputed and compared for every slot
every terminal is republished as the value of the PCS claim its private table names (argument.rs:223), and those claim values are among the entries the commitment-side preimage reproduces exactly

channels.function: mask_eval_s = (fin_s - terminal_polynomial_s) * c_s^-1, the verifier's own final check solved for the evaluation; the joint-view tool's stage 3 asserts the identity per slot on every capture

channels.how: the one disclosed identity: the zsum claim's published value is Fp2::ZERO, and the all-zero input gives exactly that, so the fibre over the zero input is non-empty and the preimage is exhibited.  The gate's controls force the value nonzero and show the fibre becomes EMPTY
channels.note: this is the channel where the fixed input is not free: a fixed input off this identity has no preimage, which is the disclosed dimension 2 of stage 2 made visible

channels.reason: the gate does not model the masking commitment's row layout (zk.rs::mask_commit: 46 a-rows holding [L_s mask coefficients | 256 pads | zeros] in value form over G_512, two b rows and two u rows of 1,024 coefficients), so no b-row preimage is exhibited.  What IS constructed is the mask coefficients those a-rows hold, together with the one functional identity this channel pins -- 512 (q[0] + q[512]) = sum_i theta^i value_i -- which the gate's CFS projection enforces and verifies
channels.what_would_close_it: a port of encode_coeffs_coset and mask_commit's row layout into this tool; no capture field is missing

channels.reason: same as the q channel: the u row that masks it is not modelled here.  The joint-view tool's stage 3 records the source fact that the proximity combination adds a uniform u row with coefficient 1
channels.what_would_close_it: the same port; no capture field is missing

channels.what_would_close_it: the same port; no capture field is missing

how: Input: row 0 -- NO PREIMAGE: 245 pad symbols cannot meet 246 distinct opened columns (the interpolant of the required values has degree 245)
one_pad_fewer_than_the_distinct_opened_c.what: Input modelled with 245 pad symbols against 246 distinct opened columns -- one blinding unknown short of the budget
one_pad_fewer_than_the_distinct_opened_c.why: with fewer pad symbols than distinct opened columns the row's pad polynomial cannot meet the opened values, so the view leaves the image of the blinding map and has no preimage.  This is the control on the side that CAN fail: at the real budget the map is onto, and then EVERY view has a preimage, which is what nothing-disclosed means

identities.identity: the LogUp sum claim: the view determines sum over data rows of rw[i] * (row sum), and the published value is 0

second_fixed_input_off_the_disclosed_ide.what: the pseudorandom fixed input on H, before and after projection onto the one identity the view discloses
second_fixed_input_off_the_disclosed_ide.why: the disclosed dimension is not a number here but a refusal: a fixed input off the LogUp plane has no preimage at all

shared_blinding_unknown_between_two_comm.honest_passes: the honest receipt shares no blinding row (the joint-view tool's stage 4 computes that the non-data block is block diagonal by role), so both preimages stand on the honest capture
shared_blinding_unknown_between_two_comm.what: one reserved mask row of a singleton opening group in A and one in H declared to be the SAME unknown
shared_blinding_unknown_between_two_comm.why: both rows belong to SINGLETON opening groups, so inside each commitment the pair's message is the unique solution of an invertible 2x2 system at every position: A forces one value on the shared unknown and H forces another.  The per-commitment preimages exist and the JOINT one does not -- the case a per-commitment acceptance cannot see

how: Input: group 0 -- NO PREIMAGE: the published claim values and the public row constraints cannot be met inside the kernel of the group-vector constraint
unsatisfiable_group_vector_0.what: Input's opening-group vector perturbed by one at message position 0, the opened columns left alone
unsatisfiable_group_vector_0.why_it_can_fire: the view's own public identities tie the channels together -- the verifier's column identity says the group vector's encoding at a sampled node equals the group combination of that column's values -- so a perturbation of one channel alone leaves the image of the blinding map and no preimage exists

how: Input: pad:group0 -- NO PREIMAGE: the pad half of this combination is not reachable from the opened columns (the residual is not divisible by the sampled nodes' vanishing polynomial)
unsatisfiable_group_vector_256.what: Input's opening-group vector perturbed by one at pad coefficient 0, the opened columns left alone
unsatisfiable_group_vector_256.why_it_can_fire: the view's own public identities tie the channels together -- the verifier's column identity says the group vector's encoding at a sampled node equals the group combination of that column's values -- so a perturbation of one channel alone leaves the image of the blinding map and no preimage exists
